annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Gate Tribe ACL & Dynamic Toll Bytecode Compiler

description: Compiles EVE Frontier Tribe access control lists, diplomatic standings, and surge-pricing toll rules into Sui Move Smart Gate AccessPolicy constraints. Use when configuring on-chain jump permissions and LUX/SUI toll schedules for a player-owned Smart Gate; for calculating optimal multi-system jump routes across existing stargates, use plan_eve_gate_route instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'gate_assembly_id' ('toll_mode' defaults to 'standing_tiered'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

toll_mode.description: Pricing curve applied to non-allied jumpers; defaults to 'standing_tiered' when omitted.

name: compile_eve_gate_acl

access_policy_move_struct.description: Compiled Sui Move AccessPolicy struct definition and entry verifier.

base_toll_mist.description: Calculated base jump toll denominated in MIST/LUX units.

hostile_block_enforced.description: True when hostile tribes are rejected at the Move witness gate.
